strings.zh: 我感觉愤怒湖的暴鲤龙{NEWLINE}眼睛里有杀气,{CLEAR}只是看了它一眼我就吓得跑回来了。
strings.en: I got the feeling the Gyarados at the{NEWLINE}Lake of Rage had murder in its eyes. One{CLEAR}look at it and I ran back here in fright.
strings.notes: RV047: omission: 我感觉 (I felt) restored; 'scared stiff' clashed with running back

strings.zh: 别看愤怒湖平时暴雨倾盆,{NEWLINE}其实每周三这里都是不下雨的。{CLEAR}湖底的地面也会在雨停时露出来。
strings.en: The Lake of Rage usually gets{NEWLINE}pouring rain, but it actually never{CLEAR}rains here on Wednesdays. When{CLEAR}the rain stops, the ground at{CLEAR}the bottom of the lake shows too.
strings.notes: Lake of Rage: no rain on Wednesdays (hack).

strings.zh: 最近愤怒湖有些异常,{NEWLINE}客人你如果没事的话,{CLEAR}暂时不要靠近那里比较好。
strings.en: Something strange is going on{NEWLINE}at the Lake of Rage lately. If{CLEAR}you don’t have business there,{CLEAR}you’d better stay away for now.

strings.zh: 嚯嚯嚯,在愤怒湖{NEWLINE}发生了奇怪的事,{CLEAR}都来这了真是赚到了！
strings.en: Ho ho ho! Strange things are{NEWLINE}happening at the Lake of Rage.{CLEAR}Coming here was a real windfall!
strings.notes: US Rocket toll line replaced: the hack's zh is a gatehouse NPC glad to have come.

strings.zh: 有几个研究员打扮的人{NEWLINE}匆匆忙忙地穿过这里,{CLEAR}把我好不容易捡的化石踩碎了。{CLEAR}我当时堵住他们索要赔偿,{CLEAR}他们就塞给了我一个技能机。{SCROLL}我的精灵都是岩石系的,{NEWLINE}学不会他们给的这个技能,{CLEAR}干脆送给你吧。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Some people dressed as researchers{NEWLINE}rushed through here and trampled{CLEAR}a fossil I’d worked hard to find.{SCROLL}I blocked their way and{NEWLINE}demanded compensation, so{CLEAR}they shoved a TM at me.{SCROLL}My Pokémon are all Rock types and{NEWLINE}can’t learn the move they gave{CLEAR}me. I might as well give it to you.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 唉,一块化石只换了一个{NEWLINE}没用的技能机,{CLEAR}真是亏大了。
strings.en: Sigh. A whole fossil for one{NEWLINE}useless TM. What a rip-off.

strings.zh: 我的菊石兽一穿过这个通道{NEWLINE}就难受地吱吱乱叫,{CLEAR}一退回来就啥事没有。{CLEAR}在搞清楚原因之前,{CLEAR}还是不要冒然离开这里了。
strings.en: Whenever my Omanyte goes through{NEWLINE}this passage, it squeals in pain. As{CLEAR}soon as it comes back, it’s fine.{SCROLL}Until I figure out why, I’d{NEWLINE}better not leave here rashly.
